messages:
Anya W: Quick QA run found a couple of microcopy + a11y nits on the Compliance dashboard. Not urgent but want to capture before the release.
Mike L: Shoot them over. I glanced at the retention table earlier and felt the region selector felt cramped on mobile.
Kai (Design): Screenshot: https://figma.redwood.ai/file/comply/dashboard-rows — the region pill truncates to 'eu-...' when project name is long. Options: wrap into second line, show a hover full text, or collapse project name to a single line and show region next to icon.
Taylor P: From accessibility POV truncation without accessible name is bad. Use aria-label on the pill like aria-label="Region: eu-west-1" and ensure the pill has title attr for mouse users.
Mike L: Also retention period copy says '30 days (default)' but for orgs with overrides it's confusing. Should we change to 'Retention: 30 days (project default)'?
Anya W: Good call. Compliance asked for clearer ownership language: 'Account default' vs 'Project override' vs 'Custom'.
Kai (Design): Proposed microcopy set:
- Retention label: 'Retention period'
- Default badge: 'Account default'
- Override badge: 'Project override'
- If custom: show 'Custom' and a tooltip 'This project uses a custom retention set by an admin.'
Taylor P: Make sure badges have 3:1 contrast at minimum per WCAG for non-text UI components; also add aria-describedby linking to the tooltip content.
Mike L: Audit log column heading currently uses 'Actor' which some folks found ambiguous. Suggest 'Actor (user/app)' or split into actor_type and actor_id columns?
Anya W: I prefer keeping one column for compactness but change heading to 'Actor (user or app)'. Add hover detail with actor_type + email/app-id.
Kai (Design): For iconography on the encryption column: instead of small key-only, consider key + small label 'BYOK' neutral chip when customer-managed. Shows at all widths except xs. For xs show a single accessible text 'BYOK'.
Taylor P: If we show text 'BYOK' ensure localization-friendly token so languages can expand. Don't hardcode abbreviations unless explained in tooltip.
Mike L: console-bot: I pushed a preview to staging: https://console-staging.redwood.ai/ops/1940123456/compliance-ui-nits — please review.
Anya W: Quick checklist before ship: update aria-labels, ensure badges have tooltip text not containing PII, change retention copy to 'Account default' phrasing, adjust Actor header, add unit tests for screen reader strings.
Kai (Design): I'll update the Figma components and export tokens. Assigning dev to Mike.
Mike L: On it — will open a small PR and add axe-core checks in CI.
Taylor P: I'll validate with the accessibility lab this week and report any parity issues.
console-bot: Reminder: UI freeze for release happens in 72h.
